title: Make the work legible
outcome: Finish two portfolio projects and assess the next six months against actual roles.

blocks.body: Question: What can you now demonstrate independently?
Mathematics: Integrate mathematical explanations, experimental reasoning, and engineering tradeoffs.
Dataset: Reuse the frozen soccer datasets and splits. For reproduction, use the selected paper’s public data if feasible; otherwise label the soccer experiment as an adaptation.
Reading: The target is a stronger ML engineering portfolio. Frontier-lab hiring is selective and is not a guaranteed outcome of 286 study hours.

blocks.title: Anthropic careers
blocks.note: Compare your evidence with a current engineering role. Requirements change. This curriculum does not guarantee a role or a credential.

blocks.title: Anthropic research
blocks.note: Select a recent public article about evaluations or model behavior. Follow its paper or methods link and record limitations.

blocks.body: Challenge: Explain and modify your core model without generated code. Defend the experimental design and describe a result you do not trust.

tasks.prompt: Finish a soccer prediction project with multiple models and a separate research reproduction with an ablation.
